extracted.name: Slow Cooker Spanish Beef Stew
extracted.description: Try this Spanish-style beef stew made with sofrito, olives, potatoes, tomatoes, garlic, and onion in your slow cooker.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 cup pitted and halved green olives
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add beef; cook until completely browned, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper; transfer to a slow cooker, retaining some drippings in the skillet.
Heat drippings in skillet; add onion and garlic. Sauté until softened, about 5 minutes; add to slow cooker.
Stir potatoes, diced tomatoes, sofrito, and olives into beef mixture.
Cook on Low until beef and potatoes fork-tender, 4 to 5 hours.
